import ast, copy, datetime, hashlib, json, math, pathlib, re, struct, sys, types
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
import numpy as np
from scipy.io import wavfile

P = pathlib.Path('/home/ollie/Documents/sound/analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/batch-tension-uncalibrated-sensitivity-v1')
J = lambda n: json.loads((P/n).read_bytes())
H = lambda b: hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def need(x, m):
    if not x: raise AssertionError(m)
def ident(n):
    b=(P/n).read_bytes(); return {'path':n,'bytes':len(b),'sha256':H(b)}
M=J('manifest.json'); plan=J('pre-call-manifest.json'); jobs=J('jobs.json'); settings=J('settings.json'); obs=J('observations.json'); status=J('actual/status.json'); meas=J('baseline-measurements.json'); author=J('author-assessment.json')
need(H((P/'manifest.json').read_bytes())=='7c1ac4b671441803d205b0860bfddd19d30183ff41540d83234bbdf0ba870f62','selected manifest')
def treecheck():
    files={str(x.relative_to(P)) for x in P.rglob('*') if x.is_file()}
    need(files=={x['path'] for x in M['files']}|{'manifest.json'},'exact tree')
    for row in M['files']:
        need(ident(row['path'])==row,'payload '+row['path'])
    need(all((P/f).stat().st_mode&0o777==0o444 for f in files),'read-only tree')
    need(len(M['files'])==2110 and sum(x['bytes'] for x in M['files'])==102726608,'payload totals')
treecheck()
need(len(plan['pins'])==1838 and len(plan['runtime_pins'])==7,'pins count')
need(J('actual/before-identities.json')==J('actual/after-identities.json')==plan['pins'],'global recorded pins')
post=J('post-analysis-identities.json'); need(post['unchanged'] is True and post['files']==plan['pins'],'post-analysis pins')
need(status['completed']==status['attempted']==222 and status['error'] is None and not status['automatic_retry'],'whole completed')
need(status['input_manifest_sha256']==H((P/'pre-call-manifest.json').read_bytes()),'precall linked')
need(len(status['results'])==222 and len({r['pid'] for r in status['results']})==222,'distinct children')
names=[s['name'] for s in settings]; variants=['baseline','libm+1','libm-1','round_down','round_up','round_zero']
need(len(names)==len(set(names))==37 and [o['name'] for o in obs['settings']]==names and list(meas)==names,'whole37 joins')
oldM=J('source/old-manifest.json')
for s in settings:
    n=s['name']; w=(P/f'baselines/{n}.wav').read_bytes(); b=(P/f'baselines/{n}.script').read_bytes()
    need(H(w)==s['old_wav_sha256']==s['old_run']['wav_sha256'] and len(w)==s['old_wav_bytes'],'retained WAV identity')
    need(H(b)==s['old_script_sha256'],'retained baseline input')
    for rel,raw in [(f'raw/{n}.wav',w),(f'raw/{n}.script',b)]:
        need(oldM['files'][rel]=={'sha256':H(raw),'bytes':len(raw)},'old manifest bridge '+rel)
    need(s['events']==s['old_run']['events'] and s['frames']==s['old_run']['frames']==44100 and s['fs']==s['old_run']['fs']==44100 and s['off']==26146,'old finite settings bridge')
    need(s['old_run']['channels_identical'] and s['old_run']['preset'] is None,'historical nonpreset mono selection')
expected_env={'PATH':'/usr/bin:/bin','LANG':'C.UTF-8','LC_ALL':'C.UTF-8','TZ':'UTC'}
want_exports=['_CreateInstanceU','_DestroyInstanceU','_SetSampleRateU','_GetPlugInfoU','_CalcA','_SetParameterA','_ResetA']
expected_addresses=['0x17690','0x17710','0x17780','0x177f0','0x178a0','0x17bb0','0x17c30']
last_finish=None; rawtotal=0; allbindings=set(); allused=set(); receiptrows=[]
for i,j in enumerate(jobs):
    s=settings[i//6]; n=s['name']; v=variants[i%6]; key=n+'--'+v
    need((j['ordinal'],j['name'],j['variant'],j['key'])==(i,n,v,key),'exact whole Cartesian order')
    b=(P/j['script']).read_bytes(); lines=b.decode().splitlines(); ps=[l.split() for l in lines if l.startswith('param ')]
    words=[{'index':int(x[1]),'token':x[2],'binary32_le':struct.pack('<f',float(x[2])).hex()} for x in ps]
    need(words==s['parameter_words']==j['parameter_words'] and [x['index'] for x in words]==[x for x in range(130) if x!=2],'all words/order')
    base=(P/f'baselines/{n}.script').read_text().splitlines()
    mx={'round_down':'0x3f80','round_up':'0x5f80','round_zero':'0x7f80'}.get(v)
    expected=base.copy()
    if mx: expected.insert(expected.index('inflag 0'),'mxcsr '+mx)
    need(lines==expected,'exact baseline plus selected MXCSR')
    need(lines[:2]==['create','rate 44100'] and lines[-4:]==['inflag 0','input zero','process 44100 512','destroy'],'whole script protocol')
    ev=[list(map(lambda z:int(z,0),l.split()[1:])) for l in lines if l.startswith('event ')]
    need(ev==s['events'],'events bridge')
    env=expected_env.copy()
    if v in ('libm+1','libm-1'): env['XDEV_LIBM_ULP']='+1' if v=='libm+1' else '-1'
    need(j['env']==env and j['mxcsr_log']==(['mxcsr '+mx] if mx else []),'phase and environment')
    d=P/'actual'/key; r=json.loads((d/'result.json').read_bytes()); before=json.loads((d/'before.json').read_bytes()); pid=json.loads((d/'pid.json').read_bytes())
    need(r==status['results'][i],'all embedded receipt equality')
    need(r['ordinal']==i and r['name']==n and r['variant']==v and r['key']==key and r['environment']==env,'receipt plan')
    argv=[plan['executable']['path'],plan['image']['path'],str(P/j['script']),str(d/'output.f32'),'--imports']
    need(r['argv']==argv==pid['argv']==before['argv'] and pid['pid']==pid['pgid']==r['pid'],'argv and pid')
    need(all(r[k]==before[k] for k in before if k not in ('pid','exit_code')),'before receipt fields')
    need(r['attempt']==1 and r['exit_code']==0 and not r['timed_out'] and r['error'] is None and r['timeout_seconds']==20 and r['core_bytes']==0 and r['stdin']=='DEVNULL' and r['new_session'] is True,'child outcome')
    need(r['custody_unchanged'] and json.loads((d/'before-identities.json').read_bytes())==json.loads((d/'after-identities.json').read_bytes())==plan['runtime_pins'],'7 child recorded identities')
    start=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(r['started_utc']); finish=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(r['finished_utc'])
    need(finish>=start and (last_finish is None or start>=last_finish),'sequential UTC')
    last_finish=finish
    out=(d/'stdout').read_text(); ol=out.splitlines(); err=(d/'stderr').read_bytes(); raw=(d/'output.f32').read_bytes()
    need(not err and len(out.encode())<=131072 and not any('TRAP' in l or 'FAULT' in l or l.startswith('xdev:') for l in ol),'diagnostics')
    need(ol.count('create ok')==ol.count('destroy')==ol.count('cxx-failbits 0')==1,'lifecycle diagnostics')
    need([l for l in ol if l.startswith('export ')]==['export '+n+' '+a for n,a in zip(want_exports,expected_addresses)],'exact export enumeration')
    need('slice offset=16384 size=501392' in ol,'x86 slice')
    params=[l.split() for l in ol if l.startswith('param ')]
    need([int(x[1]) for x in params]==[w['index'] for w in words] and [struct.pack('<f',float(x[2])).hex() for x in params]==[w['binary32_le'] for w in words],'all logged setter bits')
    need([l for l in ol if l.startswith('event ')]==j['event_log'] and [l for l in ol if l.startswith('mxcsr ')]==j['mxcsr_log'],'logged events/phase')
    proc=[l for l in ol if l.startswith('process ')]
    need(proc==['process 44100 512 flags: 87x(ret=0,flag=1) blocks=87'],'all87 block status')
    used={l.split()[1]:int(l.split()[2]) for l in ol if l.startswith('used ')}
    bindings=[l for l in ol if l.startswith('import ')]
    need(used==r['protocol']['used_imports'] and set(used)<=set(s['allowed_used_imports']) and all(x>0 for x in used.values()),'actual used imports')
    need(bindings==r['protocol']['binding_lines'],'binding declarations separate')
    allused.update(used); allbindings.update(bindings)
    need(r['protocol']['direct_export_calls']==219 and r['protocol']['CalcA_calls']==87 and len(params)+87+3==219,'direct call accounting')
    need(len(raw)==352800,'raw shape'); a=np.frombuffer(raw,dtype='<f4').reshape(44100,2)
    need(np.isfinite(a).all() and np.array_equal(a[:,0].view('<u4'),a[:,1].view('<u4')),'both channels finite/exact')
    need(r['output']['sha256']==H(raw) and r['output']['peak_left']==float(np.abs(a[:,0]).max()) and r['output']['peak_right']==float(np.abs(a[:,1]).max()),'output descriptor')
    rawtotal+=len(raw)
    receiptrows.append({'ordinal':i,'key':key,'pid':r['pid'],'started_utc':r['started_utc'],'finished_utc':r['finished_utc'],'argv_sha256':H(json.dumps(argv,separators=(',',':')).encode()),'script_sha256':H(b),'raw_sha256':H(raw),'stdout_sha256':H(out.encode()),'used_import_symbols':len(used),'custody_pairs':7})
need(rawtotal==78321600,'raw total')
# Source identity/exact function equivalence, without importing any original driver.
def function_ast(path,name):
    return ast.dump(next(n for n in ast.parse((P/path).read_text()).body if isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name==name),include_attributes=False)
need(function_ast('source/sensitivity.py','compare')==function_ast('method/compare.py','compare'),'exact historical compare AST')
for n in ['measure.py','fit.py']:
    b=(P/'method'/n).read_bytes(); need(oldM['files'][n]=={'sha256':H(b),'bytes':len(b)},'exact historical '+n)
